verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents fine-grained role-based access control and gives restricting production edits as an example, which covers the roles and permissions part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows scoped API tokens, and the public Environment Key is the opposite of a scoped credential. Missing for 10: scoped or limited-permission Admin API tokens, evidence of per-flag (not just per-environment) permission scoping, detailed permission model docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can restrict who can change which flags with roles, permissions, and scoped API tokens

citations.quote: Role-based access control (RBAC) provides fine-grained access management of Flagsmith resources.
Only allow certain users to modify your production environments.
